description: Everything the race page says about one race, by race_slug or url from search_races: every date and wave with start times, each event's distance, vertical gain and obstacle count, venue, nearest airport and how to get there, course map and route numbers (distance, climb, high point, steepest km), course videos, past results and other editions. sections narrows it to the parts you need (summary, events, venue, course, results, editions); left out, the whole race comes back. Past editions answer too, with status 'past'. site_url is the race's page, register_url the organiser's.

sections.description: Parts of the race to return: summary, events, venue, course, results, editions. Omit for all of them.

source.description: Only when the same slug exists for two kinds of race. Usually omit.

url.description: The race url from search_races, instead of race_slug.

name: get_race
title: Race details
